intro: AI agent systems engineer and technical founder. I have spent the past year on agentic systems and harness engineering, starting while I was finishing high school, where I was also wrestling team captain for two years. For most of that stretch I worked 13 to 14 hours a day on it, around school, my job and wrestling. I work across several harnesses instead of just one: OpenCode and DeepSeek Harness, Claude Desktop and Claude Code, Gemini Antigravity, and ChatGPT Codex. Four single-binary Rust + Rune + House Frontend systems make up my current v0.4.0 releases: Ergon (personal employee agent desk with live model connectivity and real file workspaces), Fleet (parallel coding-agent mission control), OpenRO (Roblox Studio game builder with real .rbxlx export), and OpenBell (paper-only Kalshi 15-minute live tape collector and Rune strategy workbench — places no orders; no order-placement code path exists).
